case_title: Refrigerator Delivery Damage and Installation Dispute

expected_checklist.reason: The claimant says she contacted the seller, but a written complaint notice is not listed.
The seller's response is described in the case.

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: No written report records the damage at the time of delivery.
The manufacturer requested an inspection, but no completed report is provided.

expected_defects.description: The claimant alleges delivery damage, while the seller says the product was delivered in sealed packaging and the receipt was signed without objection.
The photographs show damage but do not independently establish when it occurred.

expected_review.reason: The standard defect notice is unclear and a written delivery damage report is missing.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain the written complaint, delivery records and a manufacturer inspection report.

testing_notes: Check whether the system identifies the unclear defect notice.
Do not assume that photographs alone establish the time or cause of damage.
